title.zh: 消防安全（应急响应计划）条例

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en:
1. These Regulations may be cited as the Fire Safety (Emergency Response Plan) Regulations.
[S 539/2013 wef 01/09/2013]

chapter.en: PART II DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES OF OWNER OR OCCUPIER OF DESIGNATED PREMISES

heading.en: Duties of owner or occupier of designated premises

chapter.en: PART II DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES OF OWNER OR OCCUPIER OF DESIGNATED PREMISES
PART II DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES OF OWNER OR OCCUPIER OF DESIGNATED PREMISES

text.en:
5. Any person who contravenes any provision of these Regulations shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $10,000 or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding 6 months or to both.
[G.N. No. S 168/94]
